_comment: Copy this to config.json (or point env var CYFIND_CONFIG at another path). This file only holds database and skill_dir; all other config (LLM, etc.) comes from environment variables or in-app settings, not from here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: env var CYFIND_PG_DSN > this file's database. Pick one of two forms: (A) fill the individual fields below; (B) provide a single full connection string via database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing SKILL.md). Precedence: env var CYFIND_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
